data.name: Grisly Murder
data.description: A serial killer gains Dreadful Carnage as a bonus feat, and if she leaves a calling card, the murder is so horrifying that creatures examining the corpse are affected as per nightmare that night (DC %1). The nightmare affects %2 creatures, starting with the first creature to examine the corpse.|10+VigilanteLVL/2+CHA|CHA
